bug_description: tf.raw_ops.MapUnstageNoKey crashes with a fatal CHECK failure when called with an out-of-range index after MapStage. In StagingMap::popitem() (tensorflow/core/kernels/map_stage_op.cc), the local KeyType variable is passed to copy_or_move_tensors() before being assigned the real key from the map. When the requested index is out of range, copy_or_move_tensors() calls check_index() which constructs an error message by calling key.scalar<int64_t>()() on the still-uninitialized (0-element) tensor. Tensor::scalar() invokes CheckIsAlignedAndSingleElement() which asserts CHECK_EQ(1, NumElements()) — this fails (1 vs. 0) and aborts the process with SIGABRT.

        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/112757
## Description:
Issue: tensorflow/tensorflow#112757
Title: tf.raw_ops.MapUnstageNoKey crashes when works with an out-of-bounds index
State: open
Labels: type:bug, comp:ops, 2.21.0
Created at: 2026-03

Issue Body:
Combining tf.raw_ops.MapStage and tf.raw_ops.MapUnstageNoKey with an out-of-range index triggers a fatal CHECK failure and process abort. MapStage stores one value (float32) at index 0, then MapUnstageNoKey requests index 1 (which does not exist), causing the process to crash.

Crash output:
F tensorflow/core/framework/tensor.cc:904] Check failed: 1 == NumElements() (1 vs. 0) Must have a one element tensor
[1] abort (core dumped)

Root cause: In StagingMap::popitem() (map_stage_op.cc), the local key variable is passed to copy_or_move_tensors() before being assigned the actual key from the map iterator. When an out-of-bounds index is detected, check_index() tries to format an error message using key.scalar<int64_t>()() on the still-empty (0-element) key tensor. Tensor::scalar() calls CheckIsAlignedAndSingleElement() which asserts CHECK_EQ(1, NumElements()), fails (1 vs 0), and aborts.

Affected versions: TensorFlow 2.21.0 and tf-nightly. Confirmed reproducible.
